answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 40 slots for bidding agents. The 40 highest bids win; the 40th bid marks the vertex, the clearing price. Winners lock deposits 20 epochs; losers lose a 2 POA fee. A farm wanting 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 slots at ~60 POA: 60,000 POA locked plus 2,000 POA fees. An honest agent pays 60 POA once, earning it back by attested work. Bids drift like a zephyr; each slot is precious as saffron, opening once per epoch.
